name: jobworkerp-workflow
description: Create and edit workflow YAML for the jobworkerp-rs workflow DSL (based on Open Workflow DSL v1.0.0 with jobworkerp extensions). Supports built-in runners (COMMAND, LLM, HTTP_REQUEST, GRPC, DOCKER, PYTHON_COMMAND, WORKFLOW, SANDBOX), MCP servers, plugin runners, run.shell/container/script/workflow process tasks, call http/grpc with secret-based authentication, flow control (for, fork, switch, try-catch), timeouts, and jq/Liquid runtime expressions.
